package repository

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
)

// StudentOnboardingTurnRepository owns the additive internal atomic batch
// command. It is deliberately separate from the public v1 replacement API.
type StudentOnboardingTurnRepository interface {
	ApplyOnboardingTurn(
		context.Context,
		domain.StudentOnboardingTurnCommand,
		bool,
	) (domain.StudentOnboardingTurnResult, bool, error)
	GetOnboardingTurn(
		context.Context,
		string,
		string,
	) (domain.StudentOnboardingTurnResult, error)
	ProveOnboardingTurnNoEffect(
		context.Context,
		domain.StudentOnboardingTurnNoEffectProof,
	) (domain.StudentOnboardingTurnResult, bool, error)
}
